$comment: Shared cases for the id filter, read by hdf-engine/go/filter_test.go and hdf-engine/test/query.test.ts so the two evaluators cannot drift. The fixture is the REAL Grype scan from @mitre/hdf-fixtures, not a constructed document, because the defect this table pins only exists on real converter output: converters mint prefixed ids (Grype/CVE-...), so the CVE a user knows is not the id the document carries. The negative cases are the point — Grype/CVE-2018-20657 cross-references CVE-2018-12698 in its descriptions and code, and CVE-2018-12698 is not a requirement in this document at all, so `search` returns one false positive and zero true positives for it. A glob on id reads only the id, so prose cross-references cannot reach it.

cases.name: an exact prefixed id still matches exactly, as it always did
a bare CVE does not match a prefixed id without a wildcard
a leading wildcard reaches the CVE the user knows, through the converter's prefix
a glob matching the requirement's OWN cve does not match one merely mentioned in its prose
and the requirement that cross-references it is reachable by its own id
a wildcard is anchored, so a trailing fragment does not match a longer id
a glob selects every entry carrying a duplicated id, not one of them
a question-mark wildcard matches one character
a glob matching nothing selects nothing rather than everything
an exact lookup stays case-SENSITIVE, as it always was
but a glob is case-INSENSITIVE, like the tag and baseline globs
a glob wrapped on both sides reaches a CVE embedded mid-id, which the anchored form cannot
